name: facet-monorepo
description: Facet — copy-in UI components for roblox-ts, built on Lattice UI and Vela

scripts.lint: turbo run lint && pnpm -w biome check scripts test
scripts.lint:fix: turbo run lint:fix && pnpm -w biome check scripts test --write --unsafe
scripts.check:fast: pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run registry:check
scripts.check: pnpm run check:fast && pnpm run test
scripts.release:prepare: pnpm run check && pnpm run changeset:version && pnpm install --lockfile-only
scripts.release:publish: pnpm run build && pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*/*" publish --access public --no-git-checks --report-summary
scripts.release:publish:dry-run: pnpm run build && pnpm -r --filter "./packages/*/*" publish --dry-run --access public --no-git-checks --report-summary
